title: EO 14176: 80,000+ Pages Released (2025)
summary: Executive Order 14176 (Jan 23, 2025) ordered full release of JFK/RFK/MLK assassination records. On March 18, 2025 NARA released 80,000+ pages in under 24 hours — 'one of the largest single releases of records in U.S. history.' The full collection exceeds 6 million pages. As of late 2026, no official review has identified a 'smoking gun' overturning the Warren Commission's lone-gunman conclusion.
tldr: After Executive Order 14176 (Jan 23, 2025), NARA released 80,000+ pages of JFK assassination records on March 18, 2025 — in under 24 hours, called 'one of the largest single releases of records in U.S. history' — from a collection of over six million pages.
ai_summary:
AI review of the NARA news article 'National Archives Releases Thousands of JFK Assassination Records' (posted March 27, 2025), read in full:
- Trigger: Executive Order 14176 (Jan 23, 2025), under which President Trump declassified the previously-classified records; NARA released 80,000+ pages in under 24 hours on March 18, 2025.
- Scale: the full President John F. Kennedy Assassination Records Collection is over six million pages of records, photos, films, sound recordings and artifacts; most is online at Archives.gov/JFK, all available in person at College Park, Maryland, with digitization continuing.
- Public response: in the eight days after the release, these records were 'the top downloaded files from any U.S. federally-hosted website' per analytics.usa.gov.
- Note on record-summary accuracy: the document does not contain any claim about a 'smoking gun' or an official review of the Warren Commission's lone-gunman conclusion — the summary's 'no smoking gun as of late 2026' is outside what this page establishes.
